$comment: The unit LIST of English literacy, Kindergarten to Grade 3 (Daily Teaching System, Part 4.3): which teaching points make a unit, in teaching order. Authored by hand from the content graph (scripts/units/dump-points.js); scripts/units/draft-defs.js fills each lesson's worksheet types and adds a new unit to defs/en.json, which is hand-kept from then on.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Letters and Handwriting
units.metaDescription: A two-week Kindergarten unit: 7 lessons on pencil lines, finding and matching letters, writing letters, the alphabet in order, and first words to trace.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: First Words to Read
units.metaDescription: A one-week Kindergarten unit: 5 lessons on matching words to pictures, sight words, sh and ch, one and many, and a or an, each with a teacher note.

units.subject: literacy
units.title: Sorting Words and Telling Stories
units.metaDescription: A one-week Kindergarten unit: 4 lessons on sorting pictures into groups, which one does not belong, opposites, and putting a story in order.
